mapper.select: SELECT p.employee_id, p.work_item, DATE(p.created_at) AS created_at, p.expected_end_date, p.status, p.achievement_rate, m.score, p.feedback FROM performance p LEFT JOIN monthly_performance m ON m.employee_id = p.employee_id AND m.performance_year = YEAR(p.end_date) AND m.performance_month = MONTH(p.end_date) WHERE p.employee_id = #{id} AND p.created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) ORDER BY p.created_at DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.performance_id) FROM performance p INNER JOIN evaluation e ON e.employee_id = p.employee_id AND e.evaluator_id = #{employeeId} INNER JOIN performance_attachment pa ON pa.performance_id = p.performance_id WHERE p.status = 'ACTIVE' AND pa.confirmed_at IS NULL
